source_rules: Input while IsAttacking and last byte nonzero returns without buffering continuation.
Inner pre step0 and final recovery set last1; strike step1 of three sets last0.
Repeated delivered held input during strike sets one continued boolean, not a queued hit count.
Live-target strike end may SkipNext recovery; source rereads target after virtual death lookup.
Root end consumes continued. No continuation stops nonranged chain through ClearNonSticky and SetStep(count).
Type1 initial selection starts at source step0. Type2 uses original AnimationRandom, not CombatRandom or a fresh seed.
Fresh attack after interruption resets continued via the original input owner, not a fabricated constructor/reset policy.
